svg.text: Upload & transcode (orange) · streaming from a CDN (indigo)

g.text: Creator gets a pre-signed URL from the API servers
Video bytes go straight to original storage (in chunks)
Transcoding splits it into GOPs and encodes in parallel
Popular videos are distributed to the CDN
Completion event → metadata updated: video is ready
A viewer opens the video page (metadata from API)
Video streams from the nearest CDN edge (bitrate adapts)
